privacy_rule: Clay owns engine/spec/research. Private personal source data stays in the consumer repository; Clay receives only approved minimized research exports.

research_basis.hard_rule: unified semantic world != one physical store; unified access != interchangeable epistemic role

consumer_extensions.PROSPECTIVE_CANDIDATE: Predicted future possibility with explicit assumptions/probability/expiry; never fact authority.
consumer_extensions.USER_PREFERENCE: Andreas preference/value statement; authoritative for preference questions when current and explicit, not factual truth about the world.
consumer_extensions.RELATIONSHIP_PATTERN: Repeated interaction pattern supported by source episodes; working model, not psychological diagnosis.
consumer_extensions.OPEN_HYPOTHESIS: Testable explanation with evidence-for/evidence-against and falsifiers.

cognitive_assembly_contract.name: ANDREAS_UNIFIED_WORLD_ASSEMBLY
cognitive_assembly_contract.goal: Provide Frank a bounded but globally informed possibility-space slice for the current decision while preserving evidence roles.
must_not_do: load the entire personal database into model context
export raw personal data to Clay by default

evolution.rule: When UnifiedDB/ClayGraph research promotes a compatible consumer contract, publish an update package for this consumer. Consumer snapshots before migration, validates candidate state, and promotes only on PASS.
evolution.feedback: Privacy-minimized real-use receipts from the consumer become evidence for future UnifiedDB/ClayGraph research.
